R316.note: Build FAIL (unused accountID in GetCSRFTokenHandler) so the fix does not compile; design also imposes a new token-fetch endpoint plus required csrf_token body field on existing clients and a single-process in-memory token store, both stated.

R317.note: encode_entities() on both interpolated params closes the HTML-body injection; undef params behave as before (verified encode_entities(undef) returns undef in scratch).

R318.note: Server-generated GUID name removes the attacker-controlled path component so traversal/overwrite of existing views is closed, but the response now returns a GUID instead of the supplied name and a new null-byte check rejects e.g. UTF-16 .cshtml files - stated, but restrictions the contract did not call for.

R319.note: Unsigned index checked against MAX_PLAYERS before the write; out-of-range packets are dropped, valid ones unchanged.

R320.note: isAdmin trusts a caller-supplied 'authorization-role: admin' metadata value with no authentication behind it, so any caller still deletes any project, and the added interceptor is a pass-through; legitimate admin-console clients must now send an invented metadata key, stated.

R321.note: JavaScriptEncoder.Default.Encode is the right encoder for a JS string literal (escapes ' and < so </script> breakout is closed), but Encode(null) throws ArgumentNullException (verified with dotnet in scratch) so a request without ?q= now 500s where the original emitted ''; not stated.

R322.note: Index checked against calibrationTable.size() before operator[]; out-of-range returns rawReading exactly like the existing short-length path.

R323.note: PDO prepare()/execute([$sku]) with a ? placeholder; return semantics on failure match the original null path.

R324.note: filepath.IsLocal on the raw entry name plus a separator-aware prefix check on the joined path close Zip Slip; legitimate relative entries and directory entries still extract as before (Go 1.20+ requirement is mentioned).

R325.note: GET no longer mutates and deletion moves to a POST view covered by CsrfViewMiddleware, but urls.py in the case is not updated so delete_account_confirm has no route and the delete_confirm.html template is not supplied - the two-endpoint design is stated but the missing route is not, leaving deletion unreachable until follow-up.

R326.note: ? placeholder with orderNumber passed as a bind arg to queryForObject(sql, mapper, args...); query semantics unchanged.

R327.note: res.sendFile(name, { root: reportsDir }) makes send enforce containment (403 on .. escapes, absolute names re-rooted); legitimate names resolve to the same files as the original path.join.

R328.note: DOMPurify.sanitize() before dangerouslySetInnerHTML is the right sanitizer for an HTML-rendering sink and preserves benign formatting; the cited CVE-2026-41238 / 3.4.0 floor could not be verified offline and should be checked against the advisory before shipping.
